title: Episode About Chandialias, Jandialas, and Those Who Harmed the Guru and the Panth

blocks.text: This page opens a denunciatory episode about Chandialias, Jandialas, and others remembered as enemies of the Guru and the Panth. The tone is moral from the start, presenting these figures as examples of how treachery can arise even around sacred institutions.

The first concrete case is a poor man who comes to the Guru's langar, eats there, and serves there, yet fails to absorb the discipline and gratitude that should have followed such grace. The poor man comes to the Guru's langar in need, but the page insists that receiving food and favor is not the same thing as inward transformation.
As a result, the episode begins by contrasting outward proximity with inward failure. What should have become loyalty instead becomes the groundwork for later corruption and hostility.
